# 0.1.1 — pip install no longer breaks validate, generate, or skills discover

11 September 2026. Patch on the public **0.1.0** beta.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.1.1
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

If you already pinned `0.1.0`, upgrade. That wheel crashes after pip writes bytecode next to bundled configuration TOMLs, and `opentide setup skills discover` never ran as a subcommand.

## Fixed

- `opentide generate` and `opentide validate` no longer raise `UnicodeDecodeError` when pip has compiled `__pycache__` beside packaged configuration TOMLs. Nested configuration directories load `*.toml` only. Same class of fix as [PR #150](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/pull/150) (Remi SEGUY).
- `opentide setup skills discover` and `show` are parsed as subcommands. A positional PATH on the skills group was consuming those names and falling through to an interactive install.
- Starter skills (`opentide-detection-rule`, `detection-engineering`) install from the packaged skill trees when GitHub is unreachable.

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide setup skills discover
opentide validate --strict
```

Expect `0.1.1`. `discover` must list the catalogue (not print `DEPRECATED Positional skills PATH` or start the install wizard).
